name: obsidian-cli
title_zh: 终端里指挥 Obsidian 的遥控器
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口、不用装插件，在终端里就能问 Obsidian：哪些笔记没人链、哪些标签超了阈值、今天该建哪张日记。
tagline_en: Skip the GUI. Ask your vault from the terminal: orphans, backlinks, tag counts, daily notes. Official CLI, no.
desc_en: Drive the running Obsidian desktop app from the terminal via the official `obsidian` CLI. Use for vault-level semantic queries that Read/Grep cannot answer — backlinks, orphans, unresolved links, tag counts, vault-wide task lists, frontmatter property aggregation, outlines, word counts, Base queries, daily notes, templates, and plugin/theme/dev operations. Also use for `eval`-based scripting again
why_zh: 它走官方 CLI 通道，不是模拟点击或文件嗅探；能回答 Read/Grep 答不了的库级语义问题。
why_en: Uses the official CLI channel, not UI automation. Answers vault-level semantic queries—backlinks, orphans, property rollups—plus.
limit_zh: 只驱动已打开的 Obsidian 桌面版，且需装官方 CLI 并开启本地 REST API；不处理未同步的远程库。
limit_en: Requires running Obsidian desktop + official CLI + local REST API. Won't touch unsynced remote vaults. Eval scripts are your own security risk.
title_en: Remote-control Obsidian from terminal for backlinks &.
